# Full-Stack Engineer (TypeScript / React) – Patient Experience

**Company:** Verdane Care (FICTIONAL)
**Location:** Graz, Austria (hybrid) or fully remote within Austria, Germany, Croatia or Slovenia
**Employment:** Full-time, permanent (or B2B contract in Croatia on request)
**Team:** Patient Experience squad (4 engineers, 1 designer, 1 product manager)

## About the role

Verdane Care makes appointment-booking and follow-up software for private clinics and physiotherapy practices. Patients use our web app and mobile web experience to book visits, fill in intake forms, receive reminders and view exercise plans.

As a Full-Stack Engineer you will build and improve those patient-facing features end to end – from React components and accessibility to the Node.js APIs and the database behind them. You will work in a small squad with a designer and a product manager, and you will ship to production several times a week.

## What you will do

- Build new patient-facing features in React and TypeScript, with a strong focus on accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) and performance on low-end phones
- Implement Node.js (NestJS) APIs and PostgreSQL schemas to support those features
- Integrate with third-party systems such as clinic calendars, SMS providers and payment gateways
- Write unit, integration and end-to-end tests (Jest, Playwright) and keep the build green
- Take part in design reviews, usability sessions and sprint planning
- Handle personal health data responsibly: follow our GDPR and data-minimisation guidelines, support audit requests from clinic customers
- Mentor interns or junior colleagues when the opportunity arises

## What you bring

**Must have**
- 2+ years of professional experience building web applications with React and TypeScript
- Experience writing backend services in Node.js (Express, NestJS or similar) and working with SQL databases
- Understanding of semantic HTML, responsive layouts and web accessibility basics
- Experience with automated testing (unit and end-to-end) and Git-based workflows
- Awareness of web security fundamentals (authentication, OWASP Top 10) and willingness to learn the privacy requirements of health data
- Fluent English; German or Croatian is helpful for customer-facing conversations

**Nice to have**
- Experience with Next.js or other server-side rendering frameworks
- Experience in healthcare, wellness or other regulated environments
- Familiarity with AWS or a similar cloud, and with Docker
- Experience with design systems and Storybook
- Experience with analytics and A/B testing

## What we offer

- Salary range EUR 54,000 – 70,000 gross per year depending on experience (Austrian collective agreement minimum applies)
- 25 days of holiday plus the Austrian public holidays, 5 additional well-being days and a EUR 1,200 yearly education budget
- Flexible hours, a home-office stipend and a yearly team retreat
- A friendly, low-ego team that cares about the people who use our software

## How to apply

Send your CV. A short cover letter and a link to something you have built (a portfolio, a GitHub project or a live site) are welcome but optional. We reply within ten working days.

Verdane Care is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace and welcomes applications from career changers and people returning to work.

Founded in Graz in 2019 by a physiotherapist and a software engineer, it serves more than 1,900 clinics, physiotherapy practices and dental offices across Austria, Germany, Croatia and Slovenia.

Its products support online booking and reminders, digital intake and consent forms, and physiotherapy exercise plans and follow-up messages. Verdane’s guiding principles are **“Patients first. Privacy by default. Simple beats clever.”** The company prioritises accessible, easy-to-use software, with applications built to WCAG 2.2 AA and regularly audited. It is ISO 27001 certified and hosts patient data in EU data centres.

Verdane employs around 68 people across Graz and Ljubljana, with some remote colleagues. Its working practices include optional pair programming and weekly demos with clinic staff, reflecting a focus on collaboration and real users’ needs. Its engineering stack includes React, TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL.

## Verdane Care launches redesigned patient app and opens engineering hub in Ljubljana
**Graz, 22 September 2026**

Verdane Care, the Graz-based provider of appointment-booking software for private clinics, has launched a completely redesigned patient experience built on a new React-based design system. The new app cuts the median booking time from 94 to 41 seconds and passes the WCAG 2.2 AA audit commissioned from an independent accessibility consultancy.

The company also opened a small engineering hub in Ljubljana, Croatia, to recruit developers who prefer working in the Adriatic time zone. "Great engineers do not all live in Graz," said co-founder and CTO Jure Kovač. "We are hiring full-stack engineers who care about accessibility and about the people who will use the software."

Co-founder and CEO Dr. Lena Moser announced that Verdane will release a public developer API for clinic software vendors in spring 2027. The company says all patient data remains in EU data centres and that Verdane was recently re-certified under ISO 27001 without findings.

Verdane employs 68 people and plans to hire eight engineers, two designers and one data protection specialist before mid-2027.
# Careers at Verdane Care
*(fictional careers page – verdanecare.example/careers)*

## Join us and make healthcare feel human

**Engineering at Verdane**
- Front end: React, TypeScript, Next.js (marketing and clinic web), Storybook design system, Playwright
- Back end: Node.js (NestJS), PostgreSQL, Redis; AWS (Frankfurt region), Docker, GitHub Actions
- Practices: pair programming on request, weekly demos with real clinic staff, accessibility checks in CI, quarterly security reviews
- We are a small team: every engineer has a visible impact on the product within the first month.

**Benefits:** flexible hours, home-office stipend, EUR 1,200 education budget, 5 well-being days, annual retreat, mental-health support through an external provider.

**Hiring process:** short screening call (30 min) -> technical conversation (60 min, we look at a project you built) -> pairing session on a small realistic task (90 min) -> meeting with the founders.

**What we value:** curiosity, care for users, honesty about what you do not know. Career changers and bootcamp graduates with real projects are welcome to apply.

**Open roles:** Full-Stack Engineer (TypeScript/React) – Patient Experience · QA Engineer · Data Protection Specialist · Customer Support Lead (DACH)
